statement: let bad := fun n : ℕ => 4 ≤ n ∧ Even n ∧ ¬ ∃ p q : ℕ, Nat.Prime p ∧ Nat.Prime q ∧ p+q=n; ∀ ε : ℝ, 0 < ε → ∃ X₀ : ℕ, ∀ X : ℕ, X₀ ≤ X → ((@Finset.filter ℕ bad (Classical.decPred bad) (Finset.Ioc X (2*X))).card : ℝ) ≤ ε * Real.sqrt (X : ℝ)

plain_statement.zh: 待证：在每个充分大的倍增区间 (X,2X] 中，强哥猜例外偶数的个数为 o(√X)。
plain_statement.en: Show that the number of exceptional even Goldbach targets in (X,2X] is o(√X), uniformly for all sufficiently large X.

brief.zh: 从 #3806 所述均方上界丢失符号的问题出发，只在真实例外集上估计负傅里叶系数。每个漏点有大小约 X 的主弧亏损时，例外支撑上的平方和若为 o(X^(5/2)) 即足够；主弧下界也须证明。以二进区间求和可得全局 o(√X)，推出本路线的 4/7 目标。对标 Li–Liu v1 定理 2 的和问题部分，去掉对数损失并要求任意小常数。
brief.en: Exploit the sign on the actual exceptional support. Given a uniform positive major-arc floor of order X, an o(X^(5/2)) squared deficit on those targets suffices. Prove the floor as well. Dyadic summation recovers global o(√X) and hence the four-sevenths target. Compare the sum component of Li–Liu v1, Theorem 2.
